settings.headline: Grow food, grow neighbours,
settings.subtitle: Commonground connects 3,400 members and 260 community gardens through local chapters, hands-on workshops, a members-only resource library and a steady voice in city hall.

settings.headline: Membership that
settings.subtitle: Every tier includes your local chapter, member rates and the full resource library.

items.title: The member library
items.text: Toolkits, legal templates, insurance guides and every webinar recording, written by gardeners and volunteer experts.

items.title: A local chapter
items.text: Monthly meetups, shared workdays, seed swaps and a group chat full of people who know your soil.

items.title: Member rates
items.text: Lower prices at every workshop and at the Commonground Gathering, our annual three-day conference.

items.title: A voice in city hall
items.text: We track land-use rules in 40 cities and organise members when a garden is under threat.

items.title: Group insurance
items.text: Garden Group members can join our liability policy, usually for less than half the open-market price.

items.title: A real vote
items.text: Members elect the board and vote on how Supporter dues are spent. This year: 30 new gardens.

settings.headline: Pick the tier that
settings.subtitle: Twelve months, any chapter, upgrade any time. Pay-what-you-can is available on every tier.
settings.note: This site takes no payments. Join buttons open our membership partner's secure site (a placeholder link in this example).

settings.headline: Eight chapters,
settings.subtitle: Chapters run their own meetings and projects. Every member belongs to the one nearest them.

settings.headline: Your garden is better
settings.subtitle: Join today and your chapter lead will say hello within a week. Not sure yet? Come to an open event first.
